name: @agi-gateway/xcp
description: XCP client and protocol primitives: per-call authority decisions for AI agents, tools and federated nodes.
comment: No dependencies, and none wanted. The protocol primitives are string and
integer arithmetic over values this file's sibling vectors pin exactly,
and the client uses fetch(), which Node has had built in since 18. A
dependency here would be a supply-chain edge on the authorization path of
a project that enforces signed, digest-pinned manifests on everyone
`npm test` runs this port against sdk/vectors/*.json. It is wired into CI
and must pass before publish, because an SDK that disagrees with the
protocol is worse than no SDK: it fails at the point of integration,
against a gateway the integrator does not control.
